role: Stateless enum that assembles an AssistantContext (user profile, today/yesterday session snapshots, recent lite sessions, baselines, trends, analysis summary, workout history, live workout/HRV and ambient location) from inputs gathered by AssistantContextSource, for the AI assistant's system prompt.
types: ContextBuilder: enum — static builders turning HRVSession/UserSettings/baseline/trend inputs into AssistantContext snapshot structs
ContextBuilder.DerivedSampleMetrics: struct — avg/max HR, avg METs, kcal, avg cadence, alpha1 mean derived from per-tick WorkoutSample series
toplevel: No globals; extension at line 611 adds the vitals/overnight-HR/sleep sub-snapshot builders.

flags.text: Header says the builder avoids coupling to AppDependencies singletons and is stateless, but build() reads AppDependencies.current brokers and ambient location service, estimatedCalories reads settingsManager, and computeOrFetchSummary reads AND writes the shared AnalysisSummaryCache, so output depends on hidden global state and tests must override those dependencies.

units.does: Builds a full AssistantContext with generatedAt=now: profile (with effective VO2max), today snapshot from latestSession (with live training fallback/live load), yesterday snapshot (no live data), yesterday diagnostic summary, recent lite snapshots, baselines, 7/30-day trend snapshots, English analysis summary for latestSession, workout history, current live workout and live HRV snapshots from the brokers, and the ambient location snapshot.

Computes the analysis-summary snapshot for yesterday's session via computeOrFetchSummary using the session's own sleepSnapshot as sleep input, its frozen trainingSnapshot, no sleep trend and no live load, against the supplied yesterday baseline stats; nil when session nil or unanalysed.
Returns the user's manual VO2max override if set, else the HealthKit VO2max carried on the given TrainingContext when useHealthKitVO2Max is on, else nil.

branches.effect: true: return the override; false: fall through
true: return training?.vo2Max (nil when no training context); false: nil

units.does: Inside NarrativeLanguage.english, looks up the session's AnalysisSummary in the shared AnalysisSummaryCache by session id + fingerprint; on a hit maps it, on a miss runs AnalysisSummaryGenerator (training context resolved via trainingContext(for:live:), canonical baseline RMSSD = exp(lnRmssdMean), baseline HR), stores the result in the cache, and returns the mapped snapshot.

branches.effect: false: return nil (no summary in context); true: continue

branches.cond: cache has an entry for session.id whose fingerprint matches
branches.effect: true: return mapped cached summary (no regeneration); false: generate, cache, return

flags.text: The cache fingerprint (AnalysisSummaryCache.fingerprint) hashes only session fields and language, not liveLoadSnapshot, baselineStats, sleepTrend, recentSessions or the HealthKit sleepInput passed here, so a summary generated earlier with a different live training load or baseline is returned unchanged; the assistant can quote load-dependent causes/advice that are stale after a workout changes the live load the same day.

AnalysisSummaryCache holds one entry per session id, and this English entry (fingerprint includes NarrativeLanguage.isEnglish=true) overwrites the display-language entry MorningResultsViewModel stores for the same session, and vice versa; CitationQuickView reads with the display-language fingerprint, so after any assistant send its cached summary for the latest/yesterday session is a miss and the summary section is empty in non-English and English locales alike (isEnglish is false outside english{}).

units.does: Copies an AnalysisSummary into an AssistantContext.AnalysisSummarySnapshot (title, diagnostic score, explanation, probable causes with confidence/explanation, key findings, actionable steps, trend insight).

Builds UserProfileSnapshot from settings: age, sex, fitness level, effective VO2max, typical sleep, custom tags, effective max HR and whether it is a user override, resolved units preference, training-break state/reason, sleep/training-load integration flags, comeback mode active/day, scoring algorithm version, recompute flag, and training goal with blurb.

branches.effect: nil maxHR falls back to 0, giving maxHRIsUserOverride=false; a stored value at or above the minimum gives true

units.does: Compendium kcal = METs*3.5*weightKg*minutes/200 using the CURRENT settings' effectiveBodyWeightKg (75 kg fallback); nil without METs or positive duration.

branches.effect: false: nil; true: compute kcal

flags.text: Historical workouts' calories use today's body weight, not the weight at the time of the workout, so the history entries' kcal change when the user edits weight.

The Compendium kcal formula (METs*3.5*kg*min/200 with effectiveBodyWeightKg) is re-implemented in the workout card and the PDF report; the card uses active duration while this and the PDF use wall-clock duration, so the three can disagree.

flags.text: This reads with the English fingerprint (NarrativeLanguage.isEnglish=true is hashed), but MorningResultsViewModel stores its summaries outside english{} (isEnglish=false), so they never match; only summaries computeOrFetchSummary itself generated (latest and yesterday sessions) can hit. analysisTitle in the 14 lite snapshots is therefore nil for every other session, and nil for the latest session on its first build because recent is evaluated before analysisSummary; MorningResultsViewModel's comment that it shares summaries 'with the Assistant so it can reference any session the user has ever opened' is false.
